title: Sponza glTF + interactive PBR effects panel
description: Loads the Khronos Sponza glTF 2.0 sample asset (full PBR — baseColor + metallicRoughness + normal maps) directly from the Khronos sample-asset CDN, and exposes every renderer effect (IBL, shadows, SAO, tonemap, bloom, AA, edges) through a side panel so you can see exactly what each one contributes.
